mapper.select: SELECT mcd.FACTORY_CODE, mcd.EMBRYO_CODE, mcd.CHILD_MATERIAL_CODE, mcd.CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME, mcd.DOSAGE FROM t_mdm_material_consume_detail mcd WHERE IFNULL(mcd.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND mcd.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_MDM_SPECIAL_MATERIAL_RECORD smr WHERE IFNULL(smr.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND smr.MATERIAL_TYPE = '02' AND smr.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND smr.MATERIAL_CODE = mcd.CHILD_MATERIAL_CODE) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_dp_demand_plan prp LEFT JOIN t_mdm_sku_construction_ref mpc ON mpc.FACTORY_CODE = prp.FACTORY_CODE AND mpc.MATERIAL_CODE = prp.MATERIAL_CODE AND IFNULL(mpc.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 WHERE IFNULL(prp.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND mpc.ID IS NOT NULL AND prp.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND prp.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND prp.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND prp.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = #{monthPlanVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND mcd.EMBRYO_CODE = mpc.EMBRYO_CODE)

SELECT SMS.MATERIAL_CODE, SMS.MATERIAL_DESC, SMR.QUOTA * MAX( SMS.STOCK / SMS.PACKAGE_NUM ) STANDARD_LENGTH, STANDARD_LENGTH ORI_STANDARD_LENGTH, SUM( SMS.STOCK ) STOCK FROM T_MDM_SPECIAL_MATERIAL_STOCK SMS INNER JOIN T_MDM_SPECIAL_MATERIAL_RECORD SMR ON SMR.FACTORY_CODE = SMS.FACTORY_CODE AND IFNULL( SMR.IS_DELETE, 0 ) = 0 AND SMR.MATERIAL_TYPE = '02' AND SMR.MATERIAL_CODE = SMS.MATERIAL_CODE WHERE IFNULL( SMS.IS_DELETE, 0 ) = 0 AND SMS.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND SMS.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND SMS.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND SMS.STANDARD_LENGTH > 0 AND SMS.STOCK > 0 AND SMS.PACKAGE_NUM > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 0 FROM T_MDM_SPECIAL_MATERIAL_STOCK SS WHERE SS.YEAR = SMS.YEAR AND SS.MONTH = SMS.MONTH AND SS.FACTORY_CODE = SMS.FACTORY_CODE AND SS.MATERIAL_CODE = SMS.MATERIAL_CODE AND IFNULL( SS.IS_DELETE, 0 ) = 0 AND SS.STOCK_DATE > SMS.STOCK_DATE ) GROUP BY sms.MATERIAL_CODE, sms.MATERIAL_DESC, smr.quota, STANDARD_LENGTH
